notes.title: Cloud Save
notes.notes:
Greetings, friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577649/43123801e3335319b0b46590df2edb57d58dd34e.png[/img]
We're excited to announce a new update that brings part one of the new Save System.
- Cloud Saves to all the Frontline games.
All save files will be stored by Steam, meaning your progress will be safe and sound even if you reinstall the game.

We also understand that sometimes a fresh start is necessary. The option to reset your game progress is found in the Main Menu. Simply head to Options, then Profile, and hit Reset Profile if needed (this will reset all games progress - a clean start if you will)

Extra save slots will be available in the next update. Some more testing is needed but we are almost done with it.

Thank you all for your patience and support. We hope this update adds a new level of convenience to your gaming experience. Happy gaming!

notes.title: v1.0.7-v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577649/4102dfd83cfdc67fd0f5e3d91b8db6ca53708f69.jpg[/img]
[i]"Thank you, Gavianu, for your exceptional coding skills and for going above and beyond to make this update possible. Words cannot express how thankful I am for your contribution."[/i]

Patch Notes: 

NEW FEATURES:
- Introducing the Fog of War system, where units will no longer be visible at a distance, adding a new layer of strategy to every battle.
- Hot Keys: Enter - End Turn; Space Bar - Select next unit; TAB - Open/Close Purchase menu.
- Unit Leapfrog is now available, allowing units to pass through each other, optimizing movement options on all maps.
- Conquering certain locations on the map will now grant extra resources per turn, giving players more incentive for strategic expansion.
- AI opponents now have the ability to heal multiple units per turn, increasing their survivability in battles.
- The AI now possesses the "Breakthrough" ability, allowing them to attack again once an enemy has been eliminated, escalating the challenge.
- Brückenpioniere Ability - certain units can mount small bridges and pontoon allowing other friendly units to cross rivers and other hard terrain much easier.
- 24h + of Audio: Music soundtrack & Radio shows
- Prestige is gained when eliminating enemy targets.


Bug-fixing:
- We have addressed an issue where the game would occasionally freeze when a unit died from artillery support, ensuring smooth gameplay.
- Incorrect resources and turn numbers on Save/Load have been fixed, providing accurate information for players.
- Units can no longer be healed when funds are no longer available, preventing any gameplay exploits.
- Correct resources will now appear when healing units, ensuring accurate resource management.
- Fixed selection issue after passing trough an conquering a city
- Fixed broken selection after routing an enemy using "artillery support"
- Fixed End-turn button initiating on AI turn
- Fixed Next unit selecting hidden units
- Fixed incorrect resources appearing for "Very Easy Difficulty"
- Sound level tweaks (Sound and music volume in is coming)
- Fixed - Airstrike uncovering AI possitions.
